waistEase.name: Waist ease (%)
waistEase.help: Controls how wide the garment will be around the waist.

waistBalance.name: Waist balance (%)
waistBalance.help: Controls how much of the waist is part of the front piece and how much is part of the back piece.

seatEase.name: Seat ease (%)
seatEase.help: Controls how wide the garment will be around the seat.

seatBalance.name: Seat balance (%)
seatBalance.help: Controls how much of the seat is part of the front piece and how much is part of the back piece.

legHemEase.name: Leg hem ease (%)
legHemEase.help: Controls how much ease there is at the bottom of the legs.

crotchForkBalance.name: Crotch fork balance (%)
crotchForkBalance.help: Controls how far back/forward the crotch fork is placed.

crotchEase.name: Crotch ease (%)
crotchEase.help: Controls horizontal ease at the crotch fork.

crotchDrop.name: Crotch drop (%)
crotchDrop.help: Controls vertical ease at the crotch fork.

legBalance.name: Leg balance (%)
legBalance.help: Positive values move more of the fabric to the back piece, negative values to the front piece.

bibWaistDrop.name: Waist drop (%)
bibWaistDrop.help: Places extra fabric in the center of the waist, to help the garment better wrap around the belly.

legLength.name: Leg length (%)
legLength.help: Controls how long the legs of the garment will be.

waistPosition.name: Waist position (%)
waistPosition.help: Controls where the waistband is on the front of the overalls. 0 is at the natural waist and -100 is at the seat.

outseamHeight.name: Outseam height (%)
outseamHeight.help: Controls how far up past the waist the outseam extends, and thus how far up the front and back bibs separate.

pocketSlash.name: Slash pocket
pocketSlash.help: Toggles whether or not to include slash (front) pockets in the pattern.

pocketSlashOpeningWidth.name: Slash pocket opening width (%)
pocketSlashOpeningWidth.help: Controls how wide the openings of the slash pockets are.

pocketSlashOpeningHeight.name: Slash pocket opening height (%)
pocketSlashOpeningHeight.help: Controls how high the openings of the slash pockets are.

pocketSlashOpeningCurve.name: Slash pocket curve (%)
pocketSlashOpeningCurve.help: Controls the shape of the openings the slash pockets. 0 is a straight opening, while larger values are more deeply curved.

pocketSlashWidth.name: Slash pocket width (%)
pocketSlashWidth.help: Controls how wide the slash pocket bags are.

pocketSlashHeight.name: Slash pocket height (%)
pocketSlashHeight.help: Controls how deep the slash pocket bags are.

pocketSlashShieldOverlap.name: Slash pocket shield overlap (%)
pocketSlashShieldOverlap.help: Controls how far the pocket shield extends past the opening of the slash pockets.

bibHeight.name: Bib height (%)
bibHeight.help: Controls how tall the front bib is.

bibWidth.name: Bib width (%)
bibWidth.help: Controls how wide the top of the front bib is.

pocketBib.name: Bib pocket
pocketBib.help: Toggles whether to include a bib pocket in the pattern.

pocketBibVerticalPosition.name: Bib pocket vertical position (%)
pocketBibVerticalPosition.help: Controls where the bib pocket is located on the bib vertically.

pocketBibStyle.name: Bib pocket style
pocketBibStyle.help: Choose among the available types/styles of bib pockets.

pocketBibWidth.name: Bib pocket width (%)
pocketBibWidth.help: Controls how wide the top of the bib pocket is.

pocketBibHeight.name: Bib pocket height (%)
pocketBibHeight.help: Controls how tall the bib pocket is.

pocketBibFeatureWidth.name: Bib pocket feature width (%)
pocketBibFeatureWidth.help: The exact effect of this option varies based on the selected bib pocket style.

pocketBibFeatureHeight.name: Bib pocket feature height (%)
pocketBibFeatureHeight.help: The exact effect of this option varies based on the selected bib pocket style.

pocketBibFeatureCurve.name: Bib pocket feature curve (%)
pocketBibFeatureCurve.help: The exact effect of this option varies based on the selected bib pocket style.

backBibBaseAngle.name: Back bib base angle (°)
backBibBaseAngle.help: Controls the angle at which the back bib rises from side seam.

backBibBaseCurve.name: Back bib base curve (%)
backBibBaseCurve.help: Controls how strongly curved the back bib is as it rises from the side seam.

backBibHexagonVerticalPosition.name: Back bib hexagon vertical position (%)
backBibHexagonVerticalPosition.help: Controls how far up the hexagon formed by the straps crossing is.

backBibHexagonHeight.name: Back bib hexagon height (%)
backBibHexagonHeight.help: Controls how tall the hexagon formed by the straps crossing is.

backBibHexagonWidth.name: Back bib hexagon width (%)
backBibHexagonWidth.help: Controls how wide the hexagon formed by the straps crossing is.

backBibHexagonSideHeight.name: Back bib hexagon side height (%)
backBibHexagonSideHeight.help: Controls how tall the left and right sides of the hexagon formed by the straps crossing are.

strapLength.name: Strap length (%)
strapLength.help: Controls how long the straps are.

strapWidth.name: Strap width (%)
strapWidth.help: Controls how wide the straps are.

strapPosition.name: Strap position (%)
strapPosition.help: Controls where the straps are positioned with respect to the hexagon.

strapTaperPosition.name: Strap taper position (%)
strapTaperPosition.help: Controls how long the tapered portion of the straps is.

strapTaperCurve.name: Strap taper curve (%)
strapTaperCurve.help: Controls how strongly curved the taper of the straps is.

pocketBack.name: Back pocket
pocketBack.help: Toggles whether to include back pockets in the pattern.

pocketBackPositionX.name: Back pocket horizontal position (%)
pocketBackPositionX.help: Controls where the back pockets are horizontally.

pocketBackPositionY.name: Back pocket vertical position (%)
pocketBackPositionY.help: Controls where the back pockets are vertically.

pocketBackWidth.name: Back pocket width (%)
pocketBackWidth.help: Controls how wide the back pockets are.

pocketBackHeight.name: Back pocket height (%)
pocketBackHeight.help: Controls how tall the back pockets are.

pocketBackCornerWidth.name: Back pocket corner width (%)
pocketBackCornerWidth.help: Controls how wide the bottom-left and bottom-right corners of the back pocket are.

pocketBackCornerHeight.name: Back pocket corner height (%)
pocketBackCornerHeight.help: Controls how tall the bottom-left and bottom-right corners of the back pocket are.

pocketCarpenter.name: Carpenter pocket
pocketCarpenter.help: Toggles whether to include a carpenter pocket under the right back pocket.

pocketCarpenterHeight.name: Carpenter pocket height (%)
pocketCarpenterHeight.help: Controls how tall the carpenter pocket is.

pocketCarpenterAnchorX.name: Carpenter pocket anchor horizontal position (%)
pocketCarpenterAnchorX.help: Controls where the carpenter pocket is anchored under the back pocket horizontally.

pocketCarpenterAnchorY.name: Carpenter pocket anchor vertical position (%)
pocketCarpenterAnchorY.help: Controls where the carpenter pocket is anchored under the back pocket vertically.

pocketCarpenterAnchorWidth.name: Carpenter pocket anchor width (%)
pocketCarpenterAnchorWidth.help: Controls how wide the section of the carpenter pocket anchored under the back pocket is.

pocketCarpenterOpeningHeight.name: Carpenter pocket opening height (%)
pocketCarpenterOpeningHeight.help: Controls how tall the opening to the carpenter pocket is.

pocketCarpenterExtra.name: Carpenter pocket extra
pocketCarpenterExtra.help: Toggles whether to include a second pocket over the bottom portion of the carpenter pocket.

pocketCarpenterExtraHeight.name: Carpenter pocket extra height (%)
pocketCarpenterExtraHeight.help: Controls how tall to make the second carpenter pocket.

hammerLoop.name: Hammer loop
hammerLoop.help: Toggles whether to include a hammer loop under the left back pocket.

hammerLoopWidth.name: Hammer loop width (%)
hammerLoopWidth.help: How wide to make the hammer loop.

hammerLoopCornerX.name: Hammer loop corner horizontal position (%)
hammerLoopCornerX.help: Controls where the hammer loop curves towards. Used for calculating its length.

hammerLoopCornerY.name: Hammer loop corner vertical position (%)
hammerLoopCornerY.help: Controls where the hammer loop curves towards. Used for calculating its length.

hammerLoopCurve.name: Hammer loop curve (%)
hammerLoopCurve.help: Controls how deeply the hammer loop is curved. Used for calculating its length.

hammerLoopOutseam.name: Hammer loop outseam (%)
hammerLoopOutseam.help: Controls how far down the outseam the hammer loop is inserted. Used for calculating its length.

hammerLoopFirstFold.name: Hammer loop first fold (%)
hammerLoopFirstFold.help: Controls how wide the first fold of the hammer loop is.

hammerLoopSecondFold.name: Hammer loop second fold (%)
hammerLoopSecondFold.help: Controls how wide the second fold of the hammer loop is.

thighShape.name: Thigh shape (%)
thighShape.help: Controls how elongated the thighs of the garment are. Higher values are used for deeper but narrower thighs.

crossSeamCurveStart.name: Cross seam curve start (%)
crossSeamCurveStart.help: Controls where the cross seam starts curving on the back.

crossSeamCurveBend.name: Cross seam curve bend (%)
crossSeamCurveBend.help: Controls how deeply scooped the cross seam is.

crossSeamCurveAngle.name: Cross seam curve angle (°)
crossSeamCurveAngle.help: Controls at what angle the cross seam reaches the crotch fork.

crotchSeamCurveStart.name: Crotch seam curve start (%)
crotchSeamCurveStart.help: Controls where the crotch seam starts curving on the front.

crotchSeamCurveBend.name: Crotch seam curve bend (%)
crotchSeamCurveBend.help: Controls how deeply scooped the crotch seam is.

crotchSeamCurveAngle.name: Crotch seam curve angle (°)
crotchSeamCurveAngle.help: Controls at what angle the crotch seam reaches the crotch fork.

hemAllowance.name: Hem allowance (%)
hemAllowance.help: Sets how wide the hems around the front and back bibs and the straps are, as a percent of the seam allowance.

legHemAllowance.name: Leg hem allowance (%)
legHemAllowance.help: Sets how wide the hems around the legs are, as a percent of the seam allowance.

waistbandWidth.name: Waistband width (%)
waistbandWidth.help: Controls how wide the front waistband is.

waistbandLayers.name: Waistband layers
waistbandLayers.help: Sets how many layers the front waistband is folded into.

bibPocketOnFold.name: Bib pocket on fold
bibPocketOnFold.help: Toggles whether to draft the bib pocket pattern on-the-fold, or as a full pattern piece.

bibPlacketWidth.name: Bib placket width (%)
bibPlacketWidth.help: Controls how wide to make the placket at the top of the front bib.

bibPlacketLayers.name: Bib placket layers
bibPlacketLayers.help: Sets how many layers of fabric are used for the placket at the top of the front bib.
